summary: The DGA textarea: a native multi-line input with a visible label, hint, error message, an optional live character counter and opt-in auto-resize. A signal-model control: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when the surrounding UI already labels the textarea (translated).

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Placeholder (translated); never a replacement for the label.

inputs.name: hint
inputs.description: Help text under the textarea (translated), linked by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the textarea invalid.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Visible text lines; the starting height when autoResize is on.

inputs.name: maxLength
inputs.description: The native maxlength; also shows the counter. null or NaN means not set.

inputs.name: counterLabel
inputs.description: Counter template (translated) with the placeholders {count}, {max} and {remaining}; the default shows digits only ('12 / 500').

inputs.name: autoResize
inputs.description: Grows the textarea with its content instead of scrolling.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Native required plus a decorative asterisk on the label.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the textarea invalid without a message (a form field may set it).

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The new text on every input event (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true on the first blur.

a11y: The label is linked with for/id; error, hint and counter are linked with aria-describedby (in that order), and an error or invalid sets aria-invalid. Without a visible label give ariaLabel. The counter is not a live region, so it is read on focus rather than on every keystroke. The required asterisk is aria-hidden. Logical CSS: the counter sits at the inline end in RTL and LTR.
